pwa.installHint: Add Spectra to your home screen, just like a real app.

home.title: Everyone has a spectrum.
home.subtitle: Ninety seconds of playful questions and we'll draw your musical fingerprint. No imports needed.

spectrum.emptyText: A few questions and it draws itself before your eyes.

discover.emptyText: Draw your spectrum first so we know what to play you.

friends.emptyText: Music is better together. Invites are coming very soon.

playlists.emptyText: Soon: a playlist everyone agrees on (almost).

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.explain: Choose who sees what. “Friends” = only requests you accepted.
privacy.searchableHint: Others can find you in search to add you.
privacy.twinsHint: Suggest you to strangers with a spectrum very close to yours (and vice versa).

security.title: Recovery codes
security.remaining_one: You have {{count}} valid recovery code left.
security.remaining_other: You have {{count}} valid recovery codes left.
security.regenerateWarn: Your old codes will stop working. The new ones will be shown only once.

data.title: My data
data.explain: Download everything Spectra knows about you, or delete your account for good.
data.deleteWarn: Your profile, spectrum, friends and whole history will be erased. This cannot be undone.

error.title: Oops, a wrong note
error.text: Something went wrong. Reload the page and it should be fine.

auth.usernameHint: 3 to 20 characters: letters, digits or _. This is what your friends will see.
auth.privacyNote: Your email is only used to log in: it is never shown to others, and we will never email you.

configMissing.title: Spectra isn't connected yet
configMissing.text: The server connection isn't configured on this version. Please try again later.

codes.title: Your new recovery codes
codes.explain: With no email, these codes are the only way to recover your account if you forget your password. Each code works once. Keep them somewhere safe: we can't show them again.
codes.confirm: I've stored my codes safely (password manager, file, paper…).
codes.fileNote: Each code only works once. Never share them.

recover.title: Recover my account
recover.explain: Use one of your recovery codes to choose a new password.
recover.done: Done, your password has been changed.
recover.doneHint: All your devices were signed out for safety. Remember to generate new codes from your profile.

errors.email_invalid: This email address doesn't look valid.
errors.username_taken: This username is already taken (or reserved).
errors.password_weak: The password doesn't meet all the rules.
errors.email_taken: An account already exists with this email.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.invalid_code: This code isn't valid (or was already used).
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.confirmation_enabled: The server requires email confirmation, which isn't expected. Please tell the administrator.
errors.origin_not_allowed: This address isn't allowed to contact the server.
errors.server_error: The server had a problem. Try again shortly.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
